subject: Request: accelerator credits stack & reserved-capacity conversion exception
messages:
From: Elena Martin <elena@helixlabs.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixlabs.co>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood promo stacking & conversion ask for Helix Launchpad

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — the latency numbers looked great for our demo workloads. We run Helix Launchpad (early-stage accelerator) and a number of our portfolio teams are excited to try Redwood. The program includes a small promotional credit pool for startups (USD 25k total, typically non-convertible), and our operations team asked whether Redwood could make an exception so: 

- Accredited Launchpad startups can stack their promotional credits with a Dedicated reserved-capacity discount if they convert within 90 days of onboarding.
- In the event of conversion to Redwood Dedicated, Helix would like unused promotional credit to be applied toward their reserved commit as a one-time conversion (we understand this is non-standard).

Attached are our program brief and a simple usage estimate (usage_estimates.csv) for the first 3 startups we expect to onboard in September — together they look like they could move to Dedicated in Q4.

Is there a path for a short-term exception for Launchpad? If so, what paperwork or approval do you need from our side? Our CFO (Olivia) is on copy and available for a quick sync.

Appreciate it — Elena

--
Elena Martin
Program Director | Helix Labs
elena@helixlabs.co
Helix Labs — Accelerator + Community

Attachments: Helix_Proposal_Aug2026.pdf, usage_estimates.csv

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@helixlabs.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood promo stacking & conversion ask for Helix Launchpad

Elena — thanks for the context and attachments, read through quickly and this seems like a reasonable request to evaluate. Looping in Ben (pricing/discounts) and Marissa (partner ops) to scope the exception and propose the operational flow.

Quick answers up front:
- We typically do not convert promotional credits into committed billing, but we have precedent for limited exceptions when tied to a reserved-capacity commit and verified usage.
- Need to confirm conversion amount we can apply and the minimum commit term.

Ben/Marissa — can you weigh in on (1) a conversion formula we can offer, (2) minimum contract length for Dedicated, and (3) any legal/finance gating items? Elena, we'll aim to get a proposed one-pager back by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Sergio

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood promo stacking & conversion ask for Helix Launchpad

Sergio / Marissa — looked at the numbers in the usage_estimates.csv and the program brief. Proposal we can take to finance/legal: 

1) Conversion credit: allow unused promotional credits to be applied as a one-time credit toward a 3-month portion of the reserved commit. We would convert at 60% of the nominal promo value (i.e., $1 of promo = $0.60 committed credit) to account for administrative cost and potential abuse.

2) Minimum commitment: 6-month Dedicated reserved term (monthly billed), with the first invoice adjusted for the converted credit. If Helix portfolios need a shorter test window, they can take a 3-month pilot but conversion only applies if they upgrade to the 6-month commit within 90 days.

3) Discount: standard Dedicated volume discounts still apply. For Launchpad participants we can offer an introductory 10% off list on the base Dedicated rate for the first 3 months of the commit (in addition to the converted credit).

4) Approvals required: revenue ops sign-off + legal addendum to the SOW to capture conversion mechanics and proof of program eligibility.

I'll flag finance/legal for a fast review; Marissa, can you prepare a MAP and the required DocuSign artifacts? If we have sign-off by next Tuesday we can onboard the first cohort in September.

—Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood promo stacking & conversion ask for Helix Launchpad

Elena / team — thanks, this reads clean. I drafted a quick mutual action plan (MAP_Helix_Redwood_v1.docx) and a short addendum template that captures:

- Eligibility verification (Helix will provide a signed attendee roster for the cohort)
- Conversion mechanics (Ben's 60% conversion + application toward month 1–3 of commit)
- Invoice flow (converted credit applied as prepayment line on first invoice; any remainder handled via credit note)
- Proof-of-conversion window (90 days) and required signatures

I also included a DocuSign powerform link so you can sign directly — I put placeholder fields for the Helix CFO. Ben, legal needs finance ops to stamp the addendum but I left the commercial fields editable.

Elena — can you confirm Helix is comfortable with the 60% conversion rate and the 6-month minimum? If yes, I'll generate the DocuSign packet and send to Olivia for signature.

Attachments: MAP_Helix_Redwood_v1.docx

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martin <elena@helixlabs.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood promo stacking & conversion ask for Helix Launchpad

Marissa / Ben / Sergio — thanks, this all looks workable to Helix. Olivia reviewed the MAP with me and is comfortable with the 60% conversion and the 6-month minimum so long as the converted credit is applied to the first invoice and itemized for our accounting.

We'll go ahead and sign the DocuSign packet this afternoon. Quick requests before you send final: 
- Can you confirm the invoice line label you will use for converted credits (Helix needs a clear description for audit).
- Please confirm whether the converted credit will be recognized as prepaid revenue from Redwood's perspective (Olivia wants to align on revenue recognition).

Once the packet is live Olivia will sign and I will forward you the signed LOI for our records (attaching provisional: helix_signed_loi.pdf). Looking forward to moving quickly — cohort onboarding target: Sept 8.

Best — Elena
